author: LMAOHub
quote:
What an absolute disaster.
Waited over a decade for this game, and now I'm expected to go outside? Unacceptable.

Graphics? okay-ish. 30 FPS cap in 2026? My disappointment runs at a higher frame rate.

I wanted to escape reality, not pay virtual rent, sit in traffic and watch NPCs live better lives than me.
The map is ridiculously big. Drove for hours, got a speeding ticket and some nice scenery. Basically Google Maps Premium with crime.
One NPC looked at me funny. Naturally, I committed 69 felonies and Somehow I'M the bad guy?! 
I almost filed my taxes after getting arrested that's how realistic it is . 
The police? Absolute geniuses. They Appear faster than Amazon Prime. Steal a car and they're on your ass in 3 seconds. Meanwhile, Rockstar took 12 years to steal my money.
GTA 6 is also a husband pu22y whipped simulator woke slop. 
Drive around, pay bills, run errands and get blamed for everything. 
I wanted Vice City, not a marriage with a criminal record and being forced into this relationship ! She is a toxic woman. 
Development feels rushed, bugs and stutters everywhere. 

But don't worry, Metacritic will probably hand out another round of blind 10/10s. 
I crashed into a palm tree and got charged with emotional damage. 
Even the trees are pressing charges now. 
NPCs have better lives than me. One ignored me for 25 minutes, got promoted, bought a car and started a family. I was still trying to rob him. And the price?
For that money, I expected Rockstar to deliver the game personally, chauffeur me around Vice City and pay my electricity bill. 
Rockstar promised the ultimate open-world experience. Instead, I got a second job, a marriage and a criminal record with better graphics. 1/10. 
One star for the loading screen. At least something runs smoothly.
Also day 1 DLC for shops and cars, and there are so many things missing ?!?! are you people crazy or wtf ??
FYI there are probably people here that rate it 10/10 and its a Blant lie ! . 
I cant even imagine why and how they came to that conclusion....... 
wait maybe they are Pok@mon/Nint@ndo fans or perhaps woke women ? 
i cant comprehend it for real !
